title: You're Made of Dust
script: You shed skin every minute What if you tracked where all your dead skin actually ends up? You lose skin cells constantly This process is natural But that's not even the strange part You shed tens of thousands of dead skin cells every minute, and much of the dust in your home is actually made of you You replace your entire outer layer of skin roughly every two to four weeks, losing around a full pound of skin cells each year That's like filling a small bag with you every year
